items.t: Spotify Chief Financial Officer to Present at the 2026 Morgan Stanley European Technology, Media & Telecom Conference
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 17, 2026--Spotify Technology S.A. (NYSE: SPOT) announced today that Christian Luiga, Chief Financial Officer, plans to present at the 2026 Morgan Stanley European Technology, Media & Telecom Conference on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Mr. Luiga is scheduled to appear at 5:00 p.m. Central European Time.

items.t: Spotify: The Margin Story The Market Is Missing
items.sum: Analyst rates Spotify a Buy with a $700 one-year target, modeling 20% FCF-per-share CAGR and gross margins rising toward 35%-40%.
